caption.scene: School hallway; a crying/frustrated kid reacts, Duo watching.

hookVerdict: Builds the French word 'vraiment' (really/truly) syllable-by-syllable through a sentimental park-proposal scene, then hard-cuts to a completely unrelated, absurd payoff - Duo's face inside a Big Mac - subverting the syllable-building setup with a non-sequitur punchline, exactly the kind of joke that drives rewatches to confirm what just happened.
